watchFor: 找出Govern與其他風險管理功能的關係。

related.title: 安全啟動與韌體信任鏈
related.titleEn: Secure boot and firmware chains of trust
related.why: 啟動信任與身分信任均需可信根
related.whyEn: Boot and identity trust both need trusted roots
related.transfer: 啟動信任與身分信任均需可信根
related.transferEn: Boot and identity trust both need trusted roots
related.difference: 韌體驗證針對程式映像，網路授權針對工作階段
related.differenceEn: Firmware verification concerns images; network authorization concerns sessions
practice: 由「資產身分」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「韌體驗證針對程式映像，網路授權針對工作階段」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From asset identity, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.

For "Firmware verification concerns images; network authorization concerns sessions", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
